item.title: Lebanese artist turns shrapnel from Israeli munitions into art, in photos
item.description: ROUMIN, Lebanon (AP) — In southern Lebanon, visual artist Lina Jouni turns shrapnel from Israeli military munitions into sculptures, keychains and decorative objects.

item.title: What to know about Venezuela's opposition leader Maria Corina Machado
item.description: María Corina Machado has returned to Venezuela after months in exile. The Venezuelan opposition leader has been a prominent figure against the ruling party for years.

item.title: French TV channels scramble to apologize after airing Albanian protests as Paris and Lyon
item.description: Two French news channels have apologized after misidentifying protest images from Albania as demonstrations in France.

item.title: Thousands protest in Prague as government advances public media funding overhaul
item.description: Czechs have rallied in Prague to protest a government plan to overhaul funding for public broadcasters.

item.title: Uganda tightens Ebola border controls and requires returnees from Congo to pay for quarantine
item.description: Uganda is reinforcing existing border controls requiring citizens returning from Congo to undergo 21 days of quarantine at their own expense, the Health Ministry said Sunday, as investigators examine how a woman who traveled from Uganda to Nigeria contracted Ebola.
